entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: S3 bucket where users upload video files to initiate the workflow.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Orchestrates the media processing, metadata extraction, and machine learning pipelines.

entities.name: Elemental MediaConvert
entities.rationale: Generates proxy video files suitable for browser playback and visual validation.

entities.name: Rekognition
entities.rationale: Analyzes video content to detect celebrities, content moderation labels, and other visual metadata.

entities.name: Transcribe
entities.rationale: Converts audio from the video content into text.

entities.name: Comprehend
entities.rationale: Performs text analysis and entity extraction on the transcribed text.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Serves as temporary storage for extracted technical and ML metadata before ingestion.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Enclosed inside the Reach Engine platform box alongside EKS for media playback and orchestration.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Enclosed inside the Reach Engine platform box alongside EC2 for running containerized Reach Engine components.

visual_connections.description: File upload to S3 triggers the Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions initiates proxy generation in Elemental MediaConvert.
Step Functions orchestrates metadata extraction and writes metadata directly to DynamoDB.
Step Functions triggers Rekognition for video analysis.
Rekognition writes timecoded analysis results into DynamoDB.
Step Functions triggers Transcribe for speech-to-text processing.
Transcribe passes translated text to Comprehend for entity analysis.
Transcription outputs are saved to DynamoDB.
Comprehend insights and extracted entities are stored in DynamoDB.
Extracted metadata is ingested from DynamoDB into the Reach Engine platform running on EC2 and EKS.
